title: Streamlining Cross-Departmental Project Synthesis
business: A mid-sized logistics firm managing complex supply chain contracts across multiple global offices.
problem: Project managers face significant friction when manually aggregating scattered project requirements from Outlook email threads, SharePoint technical documentation, and Teams chat history, leading to delayed project kickoffs and information silos.
solution: The Microsoft 365 connector enables Claude to perform cross-platform semantic searches, allowing the AI to synthesize disparate data points from SharePoint, OneDrive, Outlook, and Teams into a unified project summary without requiring manual file exports or context switching.
steps: Authenticate the Claude Microsoft 365 connector using a valid corporate work or school account.
Grant the connector necessary read permissions to specific SharePoint libraries and Outlook folders.
Invoke the sharepoint_search and outlook_email_search tools within the Claude interface to query project-specific keywords.
Instruct Claude to synthesize the retrieved data into a structured project brief.
Review the generated output against the original source documents for accuracy and context alignment.
outcome: Project managers achieve a holistic view of project status and requirements, significantly reducing the time spent on manual information gathering and improving the consistency of project documentation.
limitation: The connector respects existing Microsoft 365 permissions, meaning Claude cannot access data that the authenticated user account is not authorized to view; verify access by checking the user's specific SharePoint or Teams folder permissions.
